purpose: Independent reconciliation of the official 2026 client decant-price PDF against the current V2 Parfums commercial staging (assets/data.js -> legacy-catalog-staging.json). Read-only evidence; no DB writes, no publication, no commercial mutation performed by this artifact.
authority_note: Operator instruction 2026-09-13: "Guiate del PDF, ese esta actualizado." The PDF is the current commercial authority for Parfums decant prices, combo composition/prices, and discontinued labeling. It contains NO full-bottle prices; bottle-price authority is out of scope here (see bottle_price_authority below).
extraction_method: pdfplumber text + word-position extraction; every visible line in the PDF renders twice (a normal line immediately followed by a character-doubled shadow duplicate) and the duplicate was mechanically discarded. 4 product name labels (pages 34/35/37/38) render as two overlapping text layers from the source PDF itself (a leftover Le Male Elixir placeholder text box behind the real label); these were decoded by character-interleave analysis and independently confirmed against (a) the exact price match to legacy_ids already present in legacy-catalog-staging.json and (b) the resulting total product count landing exactly on 96. Combo member composition for all 3 combos was confirmed by rendering page 5 to an image and reading the bottle labels visually (no member list exists as extractable text in the PDF).

price_diff_root_cause: assets/data.js:474-475 assigns the wrong shared price-template constant to two products: sauvage-edt uses T223048 (22/30/48, actually Dylan Blue's official price) and dylan-blue uses T303869 (30/38/69, actually Sauvage EDT's official price). This reads as a copy/paste swap in the legacy source, not a genuine 2026 price change. Not corrected by this gate (read-only).

discontinued_products.client_semantic_clarification: CLIENT_CONFIRMED 2026-09-13: DESCONTINUADO in the PDF means the manufacturer no longer produces the fragrance. It does NOT mean Cruzial has no stock. Cruzial owns remaining units and continues selling them. manufacturer_discontinued=true and still_sellable=true are independent and both true for these 3 products. discontinued != archived, discontinued != out_of_stock, discontinued != hidden.
discontinued_products.current_v2_model_note: apps/web/src/domains/catalog/types.ts already models this split: a boolean discontinued field (production stopped) is independent of availabilityStatus (available/out_of_stock) per the 2026-09-06 client-confirmed comment there. legacy-catalog-staging.json already carries production_status='discontinued' with availability_status='available' for all 3 of these -- consistent with the clarified semantics already. No V2 mutation is required by this fact alone.

bir_intense.pdf_status: Active/current in the official 2026 PDF, page 34, decant prices 3ml=S/26, 5ml=S/34, 10ml=S/56 (exact match to legacy-catalog-staging.json's existing bir-intense variant prices).
bir_intense.v2_current_state: legacy-catalog-staging.json: production_status='active', specs.legacy_hidden=true. assets/data.js:472 sets hidden:true with the inline comment 'hidden: CLIENT_CONFIRMED 2026-09-06 -- no lo tienen en inventario' (previously recorded in docs/client-decisions.md as bir-intense = CLIENT_CONFIRMED_HIDDEN).
bir_intense.supersession_result: The hidden decision was CLIENT_CONFIRMED on a no-stock basis. The operator's 2026-09-13 instruction to follow the updated PDF, and the PDF listing BIR Intense as a current, priced, non-discontinued product, is a newer client-facing source than the 2026-09-06 stock note. This gate records the newer source as superseding the older hidden decision; it does NOT flip the hidden flag itself (no code/data mutation in 4K-A3). The historical hidden decision and its stock-based rationale remain readable at assets/data.js:472 and docs/client-decisions.md unless 4K-B explicitly supersedes them there.

bottle_price_authority.note: All 38 pages were parsed; every priced line is one of 3 ml / 5 ml / 10 ml. No full-bottle (100 ml+) price appears anywhere in the PDF. Full-bottle prices therefore remain outside official_pdf authority; existing legacy bottle prices in assets/data.js keep verification_status='legacy' until a separate, explicit commercial decision is made (see docs/client-decisions.md -> '24 bottle prices commercial approval', still UNKNOWN).
